reason: Amendment to task 7721's spec-lane release fix (reviewer suggestion 2). git_ops.py::GitOps::_spec_lane_registered (+2, two guards): a _spec- lane still registered whose directory vanished has its registration removed with a scoped git worktree remove --force and takes create-once. Without it, releasing the lane on any exception (this task's fix) let WarmLanePool.try_acquire re-draw the same broken lane and raise WorktreeMissing on every later acquire, turning each speculative verify that drew it into a terminal block.
